tools.name: docparser_ping
tools.description: Check that the connected Docparser API key works. Returns {msg: "pong"} when it does. GET /v1/ping.

tools.name: docparser_list_parsers
tools.description: List all Document Parsers on the account (id and label). Start here: the parser id is needed by every other tool. GET /v1/parsers.

tools.name: docparser_list_parser_models
tools.description: List the model layouts of one parser (id and label). GET /v1/parser/models/{parser_id}.

tools.name: docparser_get_document_status
tools.description: Processing status of one document: importing/processing flags, page count, timestamps (uploaded, imported, processed), webhook dispatch and failed jobs. Poll this after a fetch/upload: the document is done when importing_in_progress and processing_in_progress are false, processed_at is set and faile

tools.name: docparser_get_document_results
tools.description: The parsed data of one document (the fields and tables the parser extracted, plus file name, page count and upload/processing times). Docparser allows 60 of these calls per minute. GET /v1/results/{parser_id}/{document_id}.

tools.name: docparser_list_document_results
tools.description: Parsed data of several documents of one parser: the last uploaded ones (default), or those uploaded/processed after a date. Returns up to 100 documents per call; page with offset (next_offset is null on the last page). Docparser allows 30 of these calls per minute. GET /v1/results/{parser_id}.

tools.name: docparser_fetch_document_from_url
tools.description: WRITE: ask Docparser to download a document from a publicly reachable URL and parse it with the given parser. Uses page credits of the account's plan (documents queue when credits run out). Docparser may buy extra credits by itself only if the account owner turned on automatic credit replenishment,

tools.name: docparser_upload_document
tools.description: WRITE: upload one small file as base64 content to a parser and parse it. Uses page credits of the account's plan. Docparser may buy extra credits by itself only if the account owner turned on automatic credit replenishment, or the account is on an annual plan that renews early when credits run out -

tools.name: docparser_reparse_documents
tools.description: WRITE: run the parser again over already imported documents (for example after changing parsing rules). Replaces their parsed data. Re-parsing documents already in the account does not use additional credits. 1-50 document ids per call. POST /v1/document/reparse/{parser_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: docparser_fetch_document_from_url, docparser_upload_document · Private data: docparser_ping, docparser_list_parsers, docparser_get_document_status, docparser_get_document_results, docparser_list_document_results, docparser_fetch_document_from_url, docparser_upload_document, docparser_reparse_documents · Public sink: docparser_get_document_status, docparser_get_document_results, docparser_fetch_document_from_url, docparser_upload_document, docparser_reparse_documents · Destructive: docparser_fetch_document_from_url, docparser_upload_document, docparser_reparse_documents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: docparser_fetch_document_from_url, docparser_upload_document · Private data: docparser_ping, docparser_list_parsers, docparser_get_document_status, docparser_get_document_results, docparser_list_document_results, docparser_fetch_document_from_url, docparser_upload_document, docparser_reparse_documents · Public sink: docparser_get_document_status, docparser_get_document_results, docparser_fetch_document_from_url, docparser_upload_document, docparser_reparse_documents · Destructive: docparser_fetch_document_from_url, docparser_upload_document, docparser_reparse_documents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
